lead: `rule:errors/on-limit`'s roster of resource limits is restated in four places, and three of them are prose no test reads.
body: The ADR's own list (`docs/decisions/0020.md` § 1), `nvs_runtime::Limit`'s enum doc and `Core\Fatal::onLimit`'s reference card `short` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/fatal.rs` each enumerate them, and only the enum's `name()` arm is load-bearing, so nothing fails when the other three drift. `grep -rn "cpu_time" docs/decisions crates/nvs-stdlib/src crates/nvs-runtime/src` finds all of them in one call.
